title: DecisionOutcome
description: The Reclose semantic decision outcome (CLAUDE.md Section 9.2 / Implementation Specification Section 10). Distinct from GenLayer transaction lifecycle status - never collapse into one field named 'status'. NONE is a storage/internal uninitialized value only (Implementation Specification default-state requirement); the canonical emitted DecisionRecord.outcome prohibits NONE and uses an inline restricted enum instead (A0-T3) - see DecisionRecord.schema.json.
